proposition.claim: Theorem 3.6 prints \(\Delta^2E_t=p_t[\Delta V_{t+1}-\Delta V_t+V_t(\epsilon_t-\epsilon_{t+1})]\). Its proof discards products of small terms without retaining a remainder or a quantitative condition controlling their effect on curvature.

repair.content: In this absorbing submodel the exact identity is \[\Delta^2E_t=p_t[(1-\epsilon_t)(1-\epsilon_{t+1})V_{t+2}-2(1-\epsilon_t)V_{t+1}+V_t].\] Retain the omitted remainder and require the negative leading contribution to exceed its magnitude before concluding strict concavity. A model with recovery from incorrect states needs additional terms; the absorbing formula is not a universal replacement.
